catalog.gemma_3_1b: (Q8_0) Gemma3 1B is a smaller lightweight version of the Gemma3 4B model for more complex tasks.
catalog.qwen3_0_6b: (Q8_0) Qwen3 0.6B is a tiny, very fast model for quick answers and simple tasks. Superseded by Qwen3.5 0.8B.
catalog.qwen3_1_7b: (Q8_0) Qwen3 1.7B is a much more capable version of the Qwen3-0.6B model for more complex tasks.
catalog.llama_3_2_1b: (Q8_0) Llama 3.2 1B is the smallest version of the Llama 3.2 model.
catalog.qwen3_5_0_8b: (Q8_0) Qwen3.5 0.8B is the smallest model in the Qwen3.5 family. Very fast on any phone with solid instruction following.
catalog.qwen3_5_2b: (Q8_0) Qwen3.5 2B is a strong general purpose small model with tool calling and good reasoning for its size.
catalog.qwen3_5_4b: (Q6_K) Qwen3.5 4B is the most capable Qwen3.5 model that still fits on a phone. Best accuracy, reasoning and tool calling; needs a device with 8GB+ of RAM.
catalog.qwen3_vl_2b_instruct: (Q4_K_XL) Qwen3-VL 2B is a vision-language model that can describe and answer questions about photos.
catalog.granite_3_3_2b_instruct: (Q4_K_XL) Granite 3.3 2B from IBM is tuned for RAG, summarization and tool calling. Apache 2.0 licensed.
catalog.granite_4_2_3b: (Q4_K_M) Granite 4.2 3B is the newest small Granite model with stronger reasoning and tool calling. Larger download.
catalog.lfm2_5_1_2b_instruct: (Q8_0) LFM2.5 1.2B is a very fast small model tuned for on-device chat, tool calling and 16 languages. Full quality quant.
catalog.lfm2_5_2_6b: (Q5_K_M) LFM2.5 2.6B is the most capable Liquid model for phones with strong instruction following, tool calling and reasoning.
catalog.gemma_4_e2b: (QAT Q2_K_XL) Gemma 4 E2B is Google's mobile-first model with an effective 2B parameters. Quantization-aware trained for this size.
catalog.gemma_4_e4b: (QAT Q2_K_XL) Gemma 4 E4B is the most capable Gemma that fits on a phone. Large download, needs a recent high-memory device.
